name: zgeometry_vec3_is_near_equal_xy
description: zGeometry_Vec3::IsNearEqualXY returns whether two vectors are within the supplied tolerance on both X and Y.
known_limits: Binary Ninja renders the x87 fabs/fcomp status-word comparisons as low-level floating-point flag logic. tier S verification is deferred to the coherent zGeometry model source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x469e50 validates that the function compares absolute X and Y deltas against the stack tolerance and returns one only when both pass.
The native polygon snap smoke verifies a near pair inside tolerance and the same pair outside a tighter tolerance.
